name: axioms a proof may depend on
gloss: the axioms an accepted proof may depend on, sorted alphabetically (capital letters first)

name: names of the MCP tools
gloss: the names of the MCP tools offered to a reader, sorted alphabetically

name: Lean version
gloss: the version of Lean that the Lean projects in this repository and its CI are pinned to, as a bare version number without a leading v

name: conditions a rule may ask for
gloss: the names of the conditions a row of the rules table may require for a reading of a place to stand, sorted alphabetically

name: calibration bar: read rate, in thousandths
gloss: the lowest 95% bound, in thousandths, on the rate at which a blind reader reads the altered value, for that reader to count as measured

places.at: pw-rules.json::a blind reader counts if measured.read at least

name: calibration bar: stuck rate, in thousandths
gloss: the highest 95% bound, in thousandths, on the rate at which a blind reader is stuck on the original value, for that reader to count as measured

places.at: pw-rules.json::a blind reader counts if measured.stuck at most

read.find: 引きずられる率が (0\.\d+) 以下

name: default reader model
gloss: the model ID of the Claude model that reads places by default, in pw.maintain and pw.calibrate

name: calibration bar: accept rate, in thousandths
gloss: the highest 95% bound, in thousandths, on the rate at which a blind reader reads a value off a place that is about another thing, for that reader to count as measured

places.at: pw-rules.json::a blind reader counts if measured.takes another thing for it at most

read.find: おとりを読んでしまう率が (0\.\d+) 以下
